tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the loans, cards, fixed deposits and savings accounts listed on anybanq.lk from Sri Lankan banks and finance companies. Filter by product type, bank and free-text words. sort=best puts the lowest loan rates, highest deposit rates and lowest card fees first.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Full details of one product listed on anybanq.lk: rates, fees, features, eligibility rules and documents needed, with the date AnyBanQ last verified them.

tools.name: compare_products
tools.description: Compare 2 to 5 products listed on anybanq.lk side by side. For loans, give amount and tenure to get the indicative monthly instalment of each.

tools.name: fd_rates
tools.description: The highest fixed deposit rates in Sri Lanka for a tenure, one per bank or finance company, with interest earned after the 10% AIT withholding tax and the maturity value. Tenures: 1, 3, 6, 12, 24, 36, 48, 60 months.

tools.name: loan_rates
tools.description: Loans listed on anybanq.lk ranked by indicative monthly instalment for an amount and tenure (reducing balance, at each bank's published rate). Loans whose published maximum amount or tenure is below the request are flagged and ranked last.

tools.name: card_options
tools.description: Credit or debit cards listed on anybanq.lk, lowest annual fee first, with joining fee, interest rate, features and eligibility.

tools.name: check_eligibility
tools.description: An indicative, rule-based loan eligibility check. Uses AnyBanQ's referral minimums (monthly income LKR 100,000, amount LKR 100,000) and a debt-service ratio: (existing repayments + new instalment) / monthly income below 0.5 is likely, up to 0.65 borderline, above that unlikely. tools.name: list_banks
tools.description: Sri Lankan banks and finance companies listed on anybanq.lk, with type (state bank, private bank, finance company), contact number, website, branch count and profile page.

tools.name: find_branches
tools.description: Bank branches and ATMs in Sri Lanka from the anybanq.lk locator, by bank and town. Returns address, phone and branch code.

tools.name: exchange_rates
tools.description: The Central Bank of Sri Lanka's daily indicative exchange rates, in LKR per unit of foreign currency. Optionally converts an amount. Banks' own buying and selling rates differ from these.

tools.name: unit_trusts
tools.description: Unit trust funds from the 16 wealth management companies licensed by the SEC Sri Lanka, as each manager publishes them: the SEC fund type, currency, minimum investment, management, entry and exit fees and trustee, with the manager's own fund page and factsheet. tools.description: Search the card offers and discounts running today at shops, restaurants, hotels and online stores in Sri Lanka, from every bank on anybanq.lk. tools.name: offers_near
tools.description: Card offers and discounts in or near a town or Colombo area in Sri Lanka, such as Kandy, Galle, Negombo, Kollupitiya or Colombo 7, from every bank on anybanq.lk. tools.name: get_offer
tools.description: Full details of one card offer running in Sri Lanka, as anybanq.lk lists it: the discount and its terms, every merchant, dates, and which of the bank's credit and debit cards qualify, with their anybanq.lk pages.

tools.name: start_application
tools.description: Builds the anybanq.lk application link for a product, prefilled with amount and tenure. Takes no personal details and submits nothing: the person opens the link, reviews the form, verifies their identity and submits it themselves. Give the link to the person.
